test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd letter-cluster is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36d0ca50c6341517596e904056f899a408a9b48cf1f8be73dbe4347cd132819a.png] 

2) **JMP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3436064ff564e74d5364026e52069bdf66be9d4529d4a1c28cf5e70fa225dc8.png] ⇒ **Different from others.**

3) **ORT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a205ba518148471615abfee8553d8395ccb97cf76f2edbb3a8c091b33dec4db5.png]
